title: Chilli Bean Pie
ingredients: 2 red peppers, deseeded and finely chopped
400g (14oz) can of black beans, drained and rinsed
400g (14oz) can of pinto beans, drained and rinsed
about 300g (10.5oz) sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced into fine circles
SPICE MIX: 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp garlic granules, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper
method: Prepare the spice mix. Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
Spray a flameproof casserole dish with oil and fry the red onions for 8 minutes. Add celery, garlic and peppers and stir-fry for 5 minutes, then stir in the spice mix.
Add the chopped tomatoes, black beans and pinto beans, tomato purée, sweetcorn, jalapeños (if using) and boiling water, bring to a simmer, then stir thoroughly.
Remove from heat and lay the sweet potato slices over the top, overlapping in a circle from middle to edge. Spray the top with oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 30 minutes until the sweet potatoes are cooked through and golden brown.
notes: Customise the beans to your taste. To make it meatier, fry chicken thigh fillets or lean minced beef after frying the onions in step 2.
